Key observation grounded in the repo: the dev host already IS the universal client (persistent V8 host, runtime cart loading, ~300ms hot-swap, tabs) — only the packaging shape is missing, since rjit ship fuses per-cart binaries and needs a game-bundle sibling plus a shipped player.
